Jose, who also co-wrote the screenplay with Jishnu Sreekumar. The film is produced by Mammootty Kampany and stars [[Mammootty]] and [[Vinayakan]] along with [[Rajisha Vijayan]], [[Gayatri Arun]], [[Shruti Ramachandran]] and Gibin Gopinath, in supporting roles. The film's soundtrack album was composed by [[Mujeeb Majeed]]. ''Kalamkaval'' was released in theatres on 5 December 2025. The film became a blockbuster and emerged as the [[List of Malayalam films of 2025#Box office collection|fifth highest-grossing Malayalam film of 2025]]. ==Plot== The story focuses on a serial killer named Stanley Das, who mainly targets unmarried women. The film opens in 2005 [[Nagercoil]]. We are introduced to a middle aged man (later revealed as Stanley Das), who is a father of 2 kids. He takes his mistress to a hotel and kills her when she brings up the topic of marrying her after divorcing his current wife. Movie shifts to 2012 [[Thiruvananthapuram|Trivandrum]], where Sub-Inspector Jayakrishnan investigates what initially appears to be a routine case of local unrest following the elopement of a young woman. As the inquiry deepens, Jayakrishnan begins noticing inconsistencies that suggest the incident is only a surface-level distraction. His team uncovers a long-running pattern of missing women across rural areas—divorced, widowed, or unmarried—each last seen with the same unidentified man. Further analysis reveals a disturbing alternation pattern: whenever a murder occurs in Kerala, the next takes place in rural [[Nagercoil]]. In between the investigations, we see scenes of the same middle aged man befriending the "missing" women on public buses, using them for sex, and killing them off in various ways, mainly by giving them [[cyanide]] laced pills under the pretext of preventing a possible pregnancy. The investigation reveals that each victim's phone is used to lure the next, forming a continuous chain. To strengthen the probe near the inter-state region, the team brings in a [[Tamil Nadu Police|Tamil police officer]] (who is fluent in Malayalam) posted at the closest jurisdiction near the Trivandrum–Tamil Nadu border—Stanley Das, who in fact is the actual killer. Stanley starts working with Jayakrishnan. Despite trying multiple tactics to trap the killer, the team repeatedly fails, since Stanley knows Jayakrishnan's next step. Suspicion briefly falls on a fellow constable, Mani, when a victim's phone is discovered hidden in his bedroom, leading the team to believe they may finally have the culprit. Jayakrishnan tracks down Divya, one of Stanley's victims who managed to stay alive because she did not consume the cyanide laced pills. She looks at Mani's photo and says he is not her lover, much to Jayakrishnan's disappointment. Meanwhile, Stanley finds out about this, kills Mani and threatens Divya not to cooperate with the police. Jayakrishnan then interrogates a bus conductor working in the route Divya used to take. The driver recalls seeing a man repeatedly traveling with Divya, and explains his facial features to a police sketch artist. Stanley hears about this and rushes to the spot afraid that the bus driver will expose him, but the sketch is of someone different. Stanley attempts to kill his next victim, Shiny, by taking her to a lodge at [[Kottayam]]. Suspecting scrutiny from the cashier, he steps out under the pretext of smoking and unexpectedly encounters Jayakrishnan at the main counter. Jayakrishnan hands him a paper supposedly containing the suspect's sketch and Stanley is shocked to see his face in the sketch. We see a flashback of Divya and the bus driver actually recalling Stanley's face correctly, but Jayakrishnan hides that from Stanley. Knowing he is exposed, Stanley tries to kill Jayakrishnan, ending with Jayakrishnan overpowering Stanley and smashes his head on the floor and placing his presumably dead body into the trunk of his car. The film closes with the car driving away, only for the trunk to begin opening from the inside, indicating that Stanley is alive. ==Cast== {{Cast listing| * [[Mammootty]] as [[Sub-inspector|SI]] Stanley Das {{Small|([[Crime Branch]], [[Tamil Nadu Police]])}}, (Based on [[Mohan Kumar (serial killer)|Mohan Kumar]]. Nisa as Vidhya * Mullayarasi as Pooja * Amritha as Deepika * Catherine Mariya as Mridula }} == Production == === Development === Reports for Mammootty's upcoming film came on 25 May 2024 soon after the release of his film ''[[Turbo (2024 film)|Turbo]]''. It will be directed by Jithin K. Jose in his directorial debut, who previously worked as a writer in the film [[Kurup (film)|''Kurup'']]''.'' Other details on crew that included were cinematographer [[Jomon T. John]] and music director [[Sushin Shyam]].{{Cite web |date=9 May 2024 |title=Mammootty's Next Movie With Kurup Director To Begin On May 25 |url=https://www.timesnownews.com/entertainment-news/malayalam/mammoottys-next-movie-with-kurup-director-to-begin-on-may-25-article-109979799 |access-date=5 December 2025 |website=timesnownews.com }} In September 2024, [[Vinayakan]] was reported to play a prominent role in the film that brings together Mammootty and the former after a while, and was last acted together in ''[[Daivathinte Swantham Cleetus]]'' (2013). Their past works were in ''[[Big B (film)|Big B]]'' (2007) and [[Best Actor (film)|''Best Actor'']] (2010). As per reports, Vinayakan's role was originally meant for [[Prithviraj Sukumaran]]. [[Roby Varghese Raj]]'s inclusion was also reported in 2024.{{Cite web |title=Mammootty to play villain against Vinayakan |url=https://www.onmanorama.com/entertainment/entertainment-news/2024/09/21/mammootty-to-play-villain-against-vinayakan.html |access-date=5 December 2025 |website=onmanorama.com }} Filming commenced on 25 September 2025, under the working title ''Production No. VII'' that marks the seventh production venture of Mammootty Kampany. The screenplay is co-written by Jishnu Sreekumar and Jithin K. Jose himself. The yet to be titled film's technical team after changes included cinematographer Faisal Ali and editor Praveen Prabhakar. [[Wayfarer Films]] will distribute the film in [[Kerala]].{{Cite web |title=Mammootty and Vinayakan team up; new film announcement sparks excitement |url=https://www.onmanorama.com/entertainment/entertainment-news/2024/09/26/mammootty-vinayakan-team-up-jithin-k-jose-malayalam-movie.html |access-date=5 December 2025 |website=onmanorama.com }} The official title ''Kalamkaval'' was announced by makers on 15 February 2025, that has a tagline "the venom beneath."{{cite web |title='കളങ്കാവൽ' മമ്മൂട്ടി കമ്പനിയുടെ ഏഴാമത്തെ ചിത്രത്തിന്റ് ഫസ്റ്റ് ലുക്ക് എത്തി|date=15 February 2025 |url=https://www.kairalinewsonline.com/kalamkaval-mammootty-new-movie-first-look-poster-nj1 |website=kairalinewsonline.com |access-date=24 May 2025}}{{cite web |title=Kalamkaval: Mammootty to unleash himself in another 'never-seen-before' avatar soon |date=16 February 2025 |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/malayalam/kalamkaval-mammootty-to-unleash-himself-in-another-never-seen-before-avatar-soon-9839019/ |website=The Indian Express |access-date=24 May 2025}} The film would also have music composer [[Mujeeb Majeed]] while the action sequences are choreographed by stunt director Action Santhosh.{{cite web |title=First look of Kalamkaval out, promises a 'NEVER SEEN BEFORE ... |date=15 February 2025 |url=https://english.mathrubhumi.com/movies-music/news/kalamkaval-mammootty-vinayakan-movie-first-look-edeaf630 |website=mathrubhumi.com |access-date=24 May 2025}} Last year in an interview with [[John Brittas]], Mammootty said that the film would be another attempt at experimenting with roles he had not done before.{{cite web |title=What kind of character is Mammootty playing in 'Kalamkaval'? |website=[[The Week (Indian magazine)|The Week]] |url=https://www.theweek.in/news/entertainment/2025/02/16/what-kind-of-character-is-mammootty-playing-in-kalamkaval.html|access-date=24 May 2025}} === Filming and casting === Filming started with a muhurth puja ceremony on 25 September 2024 in [[Nagercoil]].{{Cite news |date=25 September 2024 |title=Mammootty and Vinayakan starrer goes on floors in Nagercoil |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/malayalam/movies/news/mammootty-and-vinayakan-starrer-goes-on-floors-in-nagercoil/articleshow/113676120.cms |access-date=5 December 2025 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}} Mammoooty joined the set on 2 October 2024.{{Cite web |date=2 October 2024 |title=Mammootty joins the sets of his new film with Vinayakan |url=https://www.cinemaexpress.com/malayalam/news/2024/Oct/02/mammootty-joins-the-sets-of-his-new-film-with-vinayakan |access-date=5 December 2025 |website=Cinema Express }}  The film completed its shoot on 9 November 2024.{{Cite news |date=9 November 2024 |title=Shoot of Mammootty and Vinayakan's film wrapped up |url=https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/shoot-of-mammootty-and-vinayakans-film-wrapped-up/article68848986.ece |access-date=5 December 2025 |work=The Hindu |issn=0971-751X}} It was extensively across locations in Tamil Nadu.{{Cite web |title='Kalamkaval' release pushed; Mammootty–Vinayakan film awaits new date |url=https://www.onmanorama.com/entertainment/entertainment-news/2025/11/22/kalamkaval-release-date-pushed-mammootty-vinayakan.html |access-date=5 December 2025 |website=onmanorama.com }} [[Rajisha Vijayan]], who did her last role in ''[[Madhura Manohara Moham]]'' is one of the leading lady in her first association with [[Mammootty]], making her comeback after 2 years. [[Gayatri Arun]] is another female lead in her second collaboration with Mammootty after ''[[One (2021 film)|One]]'', where he played the role of the [[Chief Minister of Kerala]].{{cite web |title=21 heroines in Mammootty's upcoming film; 'Kurup' writer's directorial debut |url=https://keralakaumudi.com/en/news/mobile/news.php?id=1516950 |website=keralakaumudi.com |access-date=24 May 2025}} Gibin Gopinath, [[Shruti Ramachandran]], [[Azees Nedumangad]], [[Kunchan]], [[Biju Pappan]], [[Malavika Menon]] formed rest of the cast.{{Cite web |title=Kalamkaval OTT Release Date: Mammootty–Vinayakan Starrer To Stream On SonyLIV | url=https://www.news18.com/movies/south-cinema/kalamkaval-ott-release-date-mammootty-vinayakan-starrer-to-stream-on-sonyliv-aa-9825644.html |access-date=2026-04-28 |work=News18}} Director Jithin K Jose revealed that actor Prithviraj Sukumaran was initially considered for the role that Vinayakan has played.
